lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible along the mid-flank, transitioning into a higher-density, less-ordered cluster pattern in the anterior region near the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct grid-like matrix across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-intensity superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin contains high-luminance blobs of significantly greater diameter compared to the standard spot size observed on the lateral flank.
